title: Nvidia releases an open 120B agent model, plus a version that fits in 24GB
friendlyTitle: Nvidia releases an open agent model, including one that fits on a PC
summary: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model aimed at always-on agent work, with open weights, datasets, and training recipes. It also released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B, a 2-bit build meant to fit in 24GB and run local agent tasks on RTX and DGX Spark machines. A smaller Bolt E4B, for conversational agents in 4GB, is scheduled for 23 October. Nvidia says Super VL matches the accuracy of its largest reasoning model at about one-fifth the parameter count, and that organisations can post-train it on their own data and keep it on their own infrastructure.
friendlySummary: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open model with 120 billion parameters, for always-on agent work. The weights, training data, and recipes are open. It also released a smaller Bolt model that is meant to fit in 24GB of memory and run agent tasks on a local PC. A still smaller Bolt model, for conversation in 4GB, is due on 23 October. Nvidia says the large model is about as accurate as its biggest reasoning model, at about one-fifth the size, and that companies can train it further on their own data.
whyItMatters: If you want an agent that reads documents, calls tools, and browses without sending the job to a closed lab, this is a concrete option you can download now. The speed and accuracy claims are Nvidia's. The practical change is that the local and on-premises tiers now have a named open model, not only a cloud API.
